Temu 店铺监测

—
切到各店的商品列表页即可分别监测 ⚙ 设置

content.content:
1	Temu 店铺监测插件 · 使用说明
2	================================
3	
4	作用
5	----
6	装进你日常用的 Chrome 后，插件会定时读取你 Temu 后台的商品数据，出现下面任一情况就
7	自动往你自己的飞书群发告警，并【直接告诉你是哪条商品、附上可点开的编辑链接】：
8	  ① 在售数量下降       —— 会点名【具体哪条商品下架了】+ 链接
9	  ② 商品流量待关注 增加 —— 会点名【具体哪条商品被限流了】+ 链接
10	  ③ 商品流量近期有下降 的商品变多
11	（数据只在你本机处理，不上传任何服务器。用的就是你已经登录的 Temu 账号，
12	 不需要单独登录、不需要密码。）
13	
14	
15	一、安装（推荐方式：加载已解压的扩展）
16	--------------------------------------
17	1. 打开 Chrome，地址栏输入：  chrome://extensions
18	2. 打开右上角的「开发者模式」开关。
19	3. 点左上角「加载已解压的扩展程序」，选择本插件文件夹（就是含 manifest.json 的这个文件夹）。
20	4. 装好后，浏览器右上角会出现插件图标（可点拼图图标把它固定出来）。
21	
22	【关于 .crx 拖入】
23	 新版 Chrome 出于安全，常会拒绝或自动停用「从外部拖入的 .crx」。
24	 所以最省事、最可靠的就是上面的「加载已解压」方式，不用打包成 .crx。
25	 （如果一定要 .crx：在 chrome://extensions 点「打包扩展程序」选本文件夹生成，
26	  但对方 Chrome 仍可能拦截，不建议。）
27	
28	
29	二、配置（每人填自己的群）
30	--------------------------
31	1. 在自己的飞书群里：群设置 → 群机器人 → 添加「自定义机器人」，复制它的 Webhook 地址。
32	2. 点浏览器上的插件图标 → 「⚙ 打开设置」。
33	3. 把 Webhook 地址粘进去；「店铺名称」可填自己的店名（会显示在告警里，方便区分，留空则显示"当前店铺"）；
34	   检查间隔默认 15 分钟即可，勾选「启用监测告警」，保存。
35	4. 回到插件小面板点「测试飞书」，群里能收到测试消息就说明配好了。
36	
37	
38	三、日常使用
39	------------
40	1. 保持登录 Temu 后台，并【留一个商品列表页标签开着】：
41	     https://agentseller.temu.com/goods/list
42	   （插件靠这个页面获取数据。Chrome 关了或没开这个页就不会检查。）
43	2. 之后就不用管了。数据变差就会自动往你的飞书群发告警。
44	3. 点插件图标可看各店最新数据、上次数据/轮巡时间。
45	
46	【多店铺】如果你一个账号下有多个店：
47	· 你平时切到哪个店看，插件就自动记录+监测那个店，面板会分店显示。
48	· 另外，当你【连续几分钟没操作电脑】时，插件会自动把几个店切一圈、各自刷新一遍，
49	  完事再切回你原来的店（只在你空闲时做，避免打断你操作）。
50	· 想立刻刷新所有店，也可以点面板上的「轮巡所有店」（会切店，约 1 分钟，期间别操作页面）。
51	
52	【重要·关于"哪条下架"】首次装好、配好后，请【先手动点一次「轮巡所有店」】。
53	  这样插件会记下各店当前的在售商品清单作为对比基准；之后哪条商品下架了，才能准确
54	  告诉你是哪一条。首次这一下只是建基准、不会发告警，属正常。
55	
56	
57	四、常见问题
58	------------
59	· 面板某店显示「—」：切到那个店的 goods/list 页面刷新一下，或点「轮巡所有店」。
60	· 收不到告警：先点「测试飞书」，若测试都收不到，检查 Webhook 是否填对、机器人是否还在群里。
61	· 会告警的情况：① 在售数量【下降】（点名哪条下架+链接）；② 商品流量待关注数【增加】
62	  （点名哪条限流+链接）；③ 流量近期有下降的商品变多。
63	  数量没有变差（不变/在售上升/待关注减少）时不发消息，这是正常的。
64	· 告警里"哪条下架"始终显示"当前店铺"或旧数据：确认已按上面说的先点过一次「轮巡所有店」
65	  建基准；在售商品超过 20 条的店，因分页原因可能暂不点名下架（数量告警不受影响）。
66	· 「轮巡所有店」点了没反应/有异常：确认在 goods/list 页面、且账号能正常切店后再试。
67	
68	
69	说明：本插件不收集、不上传任何数据，所有信息只存在你本机浏览器里。
70

Temu 店铺监测插件 · 使用说明
================================

作用
----
装进你日常用的 Chrome 后，插件会定时读取你 Temu 后台的商品数据，出现下面任一情况就
自动往你自己的飞书群发告警，并【直接告诉你是哪条商品、附上可点开的编辑链接】：
  ① 在售数量下降       —— 会点名【具体哪条商品下架了】+ 链接
  ② 商品流量待关注 增加 —— 会点名【具体哪条商品被限流了】+ 链接
  ③ 商品流量近期有下降 的商品变多
（数据只在你本机处理，不上传任何服务器。用的就是你已经登录的 Temu 账号，
 不需要单独登录、不需要密码。）


一、安装（推荐方式：加载已解压的扩展）
--------------------------------------
1. 打开 Chrome，地址栏输入：  chrome://extensions
2. 打开右上角的「开发者模式」开关。
3. 点左上角「加载已解压的扩展程序」，选择本插件文件夹（就是含 manifest.json 的这个文件夹）。
4. 装好后，浏览器右上角会出现插件图标（可点拼图图标把它固定出来）。

【关于 .crx 拖入】
 新版 Chrome 出于安全，常会拒绝或自动停用「从外部拖入的 .crx」。
 所以最省事、最可靠的就是上面的「加载已解压」方式，不用打包成 .crx。
 （如果一定要 .crx：在 chrome://extensions 点「打包扩展程序」选本文件夹生成，
  但对方 Chrome 仍可能拦截，不建议。）


二、配置（每人填自己的群）
--------------------------
1. 在自己的飞书群里：群设置 → 群机器人 → 添加「自定义机器人」，复制它的 Webhook 地址。
2. 点浏览器上的插件图标 → 「⚙ 打开设置」。
3. 把 Webhook 地址粘进去；「店铺名称」可填自己的店名（会显示在告警里，方便区分，留空则显示"当前店铺"）；
   检查间隔默认 15 分钟即可，勾选「启用监测告警」，保存。
4. 回到插件小面板点「测试飞书」，群里能收到测试消息就说明配好了。


三、日常使用
------------
1. 保持登录 Temu 后台，并【留一个商品列表页标签开着】：
     https://agentseller.temu.com/goods/list
   （插件靠这个页面获取数据。Chrome 关了或没开这个页就不会检查。）
2. 之后就不用管了。数据变差就会自动往你的飞书群发告警。
3. 点插件图标可看各店最新数据、上次数据/轮巡时间。

【多店铺】如果你一个账号下有多个店：
· 你平时切到哪个店看，插件就自动记录+监测那个店，面板会分店显示。
· 另外，当你【连续几分钟没操作电脑】时，插件会自动把几个店切一圈、各自刷新一遍，
  完事再切回你原来的店（只在你空闲时做，避免打断你操作）。
· 想立刻刷新所有店，也可以点面板上的「轮巡所有店」（会切店，约 1 分钟，期间别操作页面）。

【重要·关于"哪条下架"】首次装好、配好后，请【先手动点一次「轮巡所有店」】。
  这样插件会记下各店当前的在售商品清单作为对比基准；之后哪条商品下架了，才能准确
  告诉你是哪一条。首次这一下只是建基准、不会发告警，属正常。


四、常见问题
------------
· 面板某店显示「—」：切到那个店的 goods/list 页面刷新一下，或点「轮巡所有店」。
· 收不到告警：先点「测试飞书」，若测试都收不到，检查 Webhook 是否填对、机器人是否还在群里。
· 会告警的情况：① 在售数量【下降】（点名哪条下架+链接）；② 商品流量待关注数【增加】
  （点名哪条限流+链接）；③ 流量近期有下降的商品变多。
  数量没有变差（不变/在售上升/待关注减少）时不发消息，这是正常的。
· 告警里"哪条下架"始终显示"当前店铺"或旧数据：确认已按上面说的先点过一次「轮巡所有店」
  建基准；在售商品超过 20 条的店，因分页原因可能暂不点名下架（数量告警不受影响）。
· 「轮巡所有店」点了没反应/有异常：确认在 goods/list 页面、且账号能正常切店后再试。


说明：本插件不收集、不上传任何数据，所有信息只存在你本机浏览器里。

content.text:
I have read all 9 files completely. Here is the comprehensive architectural report.

---

## Comprehensive Architecture Report: Temu Plugin Chrome Extension

### 1. MANIFEST OVERVIEW (`manifest.json`)

**Version:** 0.1.0, Manifest V3

**Permissions:**
- `storage` -- chrome.storage.local for all persisted state
- `alarms` -- periodic polling every N minutes (default 15)
- `tabs` -- query/update/reload the Temu goods-list tab
- `idle` -- detect when the user has been idle for 4 minutes (to trigger non-intrusive multi-store cycling)

**Host Permissions:**
- `https://agentseller.temu.com/*` -- the Temu seller backend
- `https://open.feishu.cn/*` -- Feishu (Lark) bot webhook for alerts
- `https://open.larksuite.com/*` -- alternative Feishu domain

**Extension components:**
- `background.js` as the service worker (background)
- `popup.html` as the default popup (action button)
- `options.html` as the options page
- `content.js` injected at `document_start` on Temu pages
- `inject.js` as a web-accessible resource (runs in page's MAIN world)

---

### 2. HIGH-LEVEL ARCHITECTURE AND DATA FLOW

```
                   ┌────────────────────────────┐
                   │     Temu Web Page (MAIN)    │
                   │         inject.js           │
                   │  hooks fetch / XHR          │
                   │  posts {__temuMon:true}     │
                   │  via window.postMessage     │
                   └──────────┬─────────────────┘
                              │ postMessage (to ISOLATED world)
                              ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                 Temu Web Page (ISOLATED)                    │
│                     content.js                              │
│  - Receives postMessage from inject.js                     │
│  - Forwards capture data to background via                 │
│    chrome.runtime.sendMessage({type:'capture'})            │
│  - Reads DOM: store name, chip counts, product table       │
│  - Periodically sends chipStats to background (2s interval)│
│  - Handles CMD from background: ping, listStores,          │
│    switchTo, scanOnSale, scanWatchList                     │
│  - Serializes DOM-mutating operations via opChain lock     │
└──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┘
                           │ chrome.runtime.sendMessage
                           ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                 Service Worker (background.js)              │
│  - Parses captured API responses (countStatus, pageQuery)  │
│  - Per-stores: per-store objects in storage.local          │
│  - diffAndAlert(): compare latest vs. snapshot, send       │
│    Feishu webhook when thresholds breached                 │
│  - diffOnSale(): track which product IDs disappeared       │
│  - cycleStores(): idle-time multi-store rotation           │
│  - Sends commands to content.js (via tabs.sendMessage)     │
│  - Handles messages from popup (getStatus, addStore,       │
│    deleteStore, checkNow, cycleNow, testFeishu)            │
└──────────────┬──────────────────┬──────────────────────────┘
               │                  │
               ▼                  ▼
┌──────────────────┐   ┌─────────────────────┐
│   chrome.storage │   │   Feishu Webhook    │
│   .local         │   │   POST (fetch)      │
│                  │   │   card-based msg    │
└──────────────────┘   └─────────────────────┘
               ▲                  ▲
               │                  │
┌──────────────┴──────────────────┴──────────────────┐
│              popup.js / options.js                 │
│  - popup.html: displays per-store stats, cycle/   │
│    check/test buttons                              │
│  - options.html: edit webhook, interval, enabled, │
│    storeName                                       │
│  - Both read/write config via chrome.storage.local│
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 3. COMPLETE MESSAGE PASSING CATALOG

#### 3A. inject.js (MAIN world) -> content.js (ISOLATED world)

**Mechanism:** `window.postMessage()`

| Direction | Data | Purpose |
|-----------|------|---------|
| inject.js -> content.js | `{ __temuMon: true, kind, url, body, mallId }` | Forward intercepted API responses (countStatus, pageQuery) from the page's MAIN world to the content script in the ISOLATED world |

`kind` values: `"countStatus"`, `"pageQuery"`

---

#### 3B. content.js -> background.js

**Mechanism:** `chrome.runtime.sendMessage()`

| Message Type | Fields | When Sent |
|---|---|---|
| `capture` | `{ type: 'capture', kind, url, body, store }` | Every time inject.js forwards an API response (countStatus or pageQuery). `store` is read from DOM. |
| `chipStats` | `{ type: 'chipStats', store, trafficWatch?, trafficDecline?, watchItems?, declineItems? }` | Every 2 seconds (throttled by deduplication key). Only sent when counts change or table rows first render. |

---

#### 3C. background.js -> content.js

**Mechanism:** `chrome.tabs.sendMessage(tabId, cmd)` (the `sendTab` / `sendTabRetry` helpers)

| Command | Payload | Response | Purpose |
|---------|---------|----------|---------|
| `ping` | `{ cmd: 'ping' }` | `{ store }` | Check if content script is alive; get current store name |
| `listStores` | `{ cmd: 'listStores' }` | `{ names }` | Open the store-switch modal, scrape visible store names |
| `switchTo` | `{ cmd: 'switchTo', target }` | `{ ok, msg }` | Click a store name in the switch modal to navigate to a different store |
| `scanOnSale` | `{ cmd: 'scanOnSale' }` | `{ store, items[], onSaleTabCount }` | Switch to the "On Sale" tab, scan visible product rows for productId/name/skc, then reset back to "All" tab |
| `scanWatchList` | `{ cmd: 'scanWatchList' }` | `{ store, items[], total, applied }` | Click the "Product Traffic Needs Attention" quick filter chip, scan the filtered rows, then reset filters |

All of these commands (except `ping`) are serialized through the `withLock()` mutual exclusion lock in content.js.

---

#### 3D. popup.js -> background.js

**Mechanism:** `chrome.runtime.sendMessage()` via the `send(type, extra)` helper

| Message Type | Fields | Response | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `getStatus` | `{ type: 'getStatus' }` | `{ bgVersion, config, stores, lastAlert?, lastCycle? }` | Popup refreshes; fetches full state snapshot |
| `addStore` | `{ type: 'addStore', name }` | `{ ok, msg }` | Manually add a store to the monitored list |
| `deleteStore` | `{ type: 'deleteStore', name }` | `{ ok, msg }` | Remove a store from the monitored list |
| `checkNow` | `{ type: 'checkNow' }` | `{ ok, msg }` | Force-reload or navigate the Temu goods-list tab |
| `cycleNow` | `{ type: 'cycleNow' }` | `{ ok, msg }` | Manually trigger a full multi-store rotation cycle |
| `testFeishu` | `{ type: 'testFeishu' }` | `{ ok, msg }` | Send a test message to the configured Feishu webhook |

---

#### 3E. options.js -> chrome.storage.local (direct write, no messaging)

options.js writes `config` directly to `chrome.storage.local`. The background service worker listens for `chrome.storage.onChanged` on the `config` key and reconfigures the alarm when it changes.

### 6. FEISHU ALERT COMMUNICATION

**Location:** `background.js`, function `sendFeishu()`

**Protocol:** HTTP POST via `fetch()` to the user-configured webhook URL.

**Format:** Feishu interactive card message:

```javascript
{
  msg_type: 'interactive',
  card: {
    header: {
      title: { tag: 'plain_text', content: title },  // e.g. "🔔 Temu 店铺监测告警"
      template: 'red'
    },
    elements: [{
      tag: 'div',
      text: { tag: 'lark_md', content: lines.join('\n') }
    }]
  }
}
```

**Success detection logic:**
```javascript
const ok = resp.ok && (data.code === 0 || data.StatusCode === 0 || data.code === undefined);
```
It accepts success when either `code === 0` (Lark/Feishu standard) or `StatusCode === 0` (alternative format) or when `code` is simply absent (some configurations return no code field on success).

**All alert triggers (and the card content they produce):**

1. **On-sale count decreases** (in `_diffAndAlert`): Title "Temu店铺监测告警", body includes "在售数量下降：N -> M"
2. **Traffic-watch count increases** (in `_diffAndAlert`): Body includes "商品流量待关注增加：N -> M" plus item-specific links (product name + edit URL) obtained by actively clicking the filter chip via `scanWatchViaTab`
3. **Traffic-decline count increases** (in `_diffAndAlert`): Body includes "商品流量近期有下降增加：N -> M" plus item links from `declineItems`
4. **Delisted products detected** (in `diffOnSale`): Body includes "在售商品下架 N 个" plus specific product names and edit links
5. **Test message** (from `testFeishu` popup action): Title "Temu监测测试", body is a simple confirmation message

**Last alert tracking:** After each alert send, `lastAlert` is written to `chrome.storage.local` with `{ ts, ok, msg, store, lines }`.

### 7. ERROR HANDLING PATTERNS

**Populated across all files:**

| Pattern | Where | Description |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| try/catch with swallowed errors | inject.js (all hook functions), content.js (message forwarding, interval reads), background.js (message handler) | Non-critical operations silently fail to prevent cascading failures. Notably, `sendTab` catches `chrome.runtime.lastError` and returns `null`. |
| Null-return on parse failure | background.js `parseCountStatus()`, `parsePageQuery()` | Return `null` if JSON parse fails or expected structure missing; caller checks for null before proceeding. |
| `sendTabRetry` with exponential backoff | background.js | Retries `chrome.tabs.sendMessage` up to N times (default 8) with 1-second delays between attempts. Returns null if all retries exhausted. |
| `waitFor` polling helper | content.js | Polls a function until it returns truthy, with configurable timeout (default 6s). Returns null on timeout. |
| `withLock` mutual exclusion | content.js | Serializes all DOM-mutating operations (`listStores`, `switchTo`, `scanOnSale`, `scanWatchList`) through a promise chain to prevent concurrent filter/tab mutations from producing corrupted reads. |
| Deduplication before sending | content.js (chipStats interval) | Only sends `chipStats` if the payload JSON has changed from the last sent value (`key === lastKey` comparison). |
| Alert chain serialization (`alertChains`) | background.js | Per-store promise chains ensure that concurrent `diffAndAlert` calls for the same store execute serially, preventing duplicate alerts from race conditions. |
| Snapshot re-read before write | background.js (`_diffAndAlert`, `diffOnSale`) | After processing alerts, re-reads stores from storage before writing updated snapshots to avoid overwriting concurrent updates. |
| Guard against incomplete scans | background.js (`diffOnSale`) | If `items.length < onSaleTabCount`, the scan is considered incomplete and the diff is skipped (returns 0). |
| `readyOrTimedOut` guard | content.js (chipStats interval) | Waits for table rows to render before sending chipStats with detailed product scans. Falls back to count-only after ~16 seconds. |
| Error display in popup | popup.js (`setMsg`) | Messages displayed in green (`ok`) or red (`err`) CSS classes with text content from `msg` field. |
| Modal close on failure | content.js (`switchTo`, `listStores`) | Always calls `closeModal()` before returning from operations that open the store-switch modal. |
| Config default fallback | background.js, options.js, popup.js | `DEFAULT_CONFIG` object merged with stored config; missing keys get defaults. |

### 8. KEY ALGORITHMS AND DATA STRUCTURES

#### Per-Store Data Structure in `chrome.storage.local.stores`:
```javascript
{
  "StoreName1": {
    latest: {
      onSale: number|null,        // from countStatus API
      unpublished: number|null,   // from countStatus API
      removed: number|null,       // from countStatus API
      deleted: number|null,       // from countStatus API
      total: number|null,         // from pageQuery API
      trafficWatch: number|null,  // from DOM chip count
      trafficDecline: number|null,// from DOM badge count
      watchItems: [{productId, name, skc}],   // current-page flagged items
      declineItems: [{productId, name, skc}], // current-page flagged items
      ts: timestamp
    },
    snapshot: {
      onSale: number,
      total: number,
      trafficWatch: number,
      trafficDecline: number,
      onSaleIds: { productId: {name, skc} },  // diffOnSale comparison base
      onSaleIdsTs: timestamp,
      ts: timestamp
    }
  }
}
```

#### Alert Condition Logic (in `_diffAndAlert`):
- `latest.onSale < snapshot.onSale` -> On-sale count decrease alert
- `latest.trafficWatch > snapshot.trafficWatch` -> Traffic-watch increase alert (+ actively scan for specific items)
- `latest.trafficDecline > snapshot.trafficDecline` -> Declining-traffic increase alert (+ items already in `latest.declineItems`)
- After alerting, the snapshot is updated to match the latest values (so the same condition does not fire again).

#### diffOnSale Logic:
- Builds a map of `productId -> {name, skc}` from the scanned on-sale items
- Compares against the previous snapshot's `onSaleIds` map
- Any productId in the old map but not in the new map is a delisted (off-shelf) product
- Guards: skips if items.length < known on-sale count (incomplete scan), skips if items array is empty

#### Multi-Store Cycling (`cycleStores`, idle-triggered):
1. Find the goods-list tab
2. Ping content script to get current store
3. Get known store names (from storage records) or probe the switch modal
4. For each store that is not the current one: switch to it, wait for capture, scan on-sale list for delisted items
5. Switch back to the original store, scan it too
6. Log summary to `lastCycle` in storage

| scanWatchList filter effect wait | content.js | 8 seconds timeout, polling every 300ms |
| Filter reset wait | content.js | 6 seconds timeout, polling every 300ms |
| On-sale tab render wait | content.js | 8 seconds timeout, polling every 300ms |
| chipStats count-only fallback | content.js | After ~16 seconds without table rows |
| Saved confirmation display | options.js | 2 seconds |

### 10. DOM MANIPULATION AND SELECTORS (Content Script)

The content script relies heavily on fragile DOM selectors. Here is a summary of the key ones:

| Target | Selector / Strategy |
|--------|-------------------|
| Store name | All `span,a,div,button,p` in top-right quadrant (left > 50% width, top < 90px), matching English word pattern, filtered by heuristics |
| Table rows | `[data-testid="beast-core-table-body-tr"]` |
| Tab labels | `[data-testid="beast-core-tab-itemLabel"]` |
| Quick-filter chip | `[class*="use-quick-field_tsx_card__"]` with text matching label |
| Chip count | `.querySelector('[class*="countDistance"]')` inside the chip card |
| "Reset" button | Text elements matching `/^重置$/` with length <= 6 |
| Modal open detection | Text elements matching `/切换店铺|您的账户存在/` with length <= 20 |
| Close button | `[aria-label="Close"], [aria-label="关闭"], .beast-core-modal-close, .semi-modal-close, .SnowModal_closeIcon` |
| Total count | Element with exactly 0 children matching `/共有\s*[\d,]+\s*条/` |
